Comedy in Amsterdam this week

All this week's events

23 – 29 Nov · 4 events

Stand-up, improv, sketch and other comedy nights, from open mics to full-length shows. Many listings say whether a show is in English or Dutch, so it is easy to pick one you will follow. The list is refreshed every week. Every listing is checked on the organiser's own page. Times and prices can change, so check the organiser's link before you go.
